notes.title: An Award, an Expo, and a Demo?! 🐾
notes.content:
[h3]Hi, Chefs!
[/h3][p][/p][p]We've got some exciting news for Dogwood! 
[/p][p]First off, we are incredibly honored and humbled to announce that Dogwood has won an award at the[b] Young Creatives Challenge Season 2 [/b]competition[b]![/b] We are so grateful for this recognition and want to extend a huge thank you to the judges, contestants, and all of you, who has supported us on this journey.  As for other news... [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596770/f13ab7b2053bb36cdd04364581838db32a81d1a3.png"][/img][/p][h2]Come See Us at PGDX!

[/h2][p]That's right! Team Soleil will have a booth at the [b]Philippine GameDev Expo (PGDX)[/b] from [b]July 25-27, 2025[/b], at the [b]SMX Convention Center Manila[/b].   [/p][p][/p][p]We first attended PGDX two years ago and thought: "We'll be there with them one day." And now we will! [/p][p][/p][p]Come by our booth to say hi and play our [b]exclusive demo of Dogwood[/b]. We've got a lot of never-before-seen content for it and we'd love to experience it with you.    [/p][p][/p][p]Here's a little concept art of the brand-new town we're working on:  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596770/cb459d8e88d86f151cdb209626d7bde4cd28ce08.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you once again for your continual support. It means a lot to us that you're sticking with us in this journey.   [/p][p][/p][h3]Wishlist and follow Dogwood here on Steam and our socials below to get all the latest updates!   [/h3][p][/p][p]With all our thanks, [/p][p][b]Team Soleil🌻[/b][/p]
